- [EVENT] User is planning to book a tour to visit Alcatraz Island.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To book a tour to visit Alcatraz Island, visit the official website www.alcatrazislandtickets.com.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tours run every day from 8:45 am to 9:25 pm, with departures approximately every half hour.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User can choose between day tours and night tours; day tours operate during the day, while night tours are limited to a few evenings per week and have a limited number of tickets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User needs to select the number of tickets needed, as tickets are only sold online and often sell out weeks in advance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Payment for tickets can be made using a debit or credit card through a secure payment gateway.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] After purchasing tickets, the user will receive an e-mail confirmation with booking details, including date, time, and booking reference number.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should arrive at the pier at least 30 minutes before the scheduled departure time and show tickets and ID to board the ferry.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] During the tour, users can explore the island, visit the prison, and listen to an audio guide about the island's history.
- [PREFERENCE] User expresses excitement about exploring Alcatraz Island.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant encourages the user to enjoy their visit and suggests bringing a camera and comfortable walking shoes.
